title: Revit preflight evidence package completeness
test_intent: Determine whether the Revit preflight package is reproducible, scoped to a known model state, linked to governing checks, and supported by traceable results and deviations before it is consumed by a higher-level readiness or approval workflow.

applicability.applies_when: A Revit model state or issue package is submitted into a governed QA/QC validation, milestone-readiness, coordination, or delivery gate that requires preflight evidence.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The governing workflow does not require a Revit preflight evidence package for the tested state.

required_evidence: applicable check identities and governing-object references
recorded result state for each applicable check
evidence references required by each check
unresolved deviation records and disposition traces

result_logic.pass: The preflight package identifies a reproducible model state, includes every applicable governed check with a recorded result and required evidence, and traces unresolved deviations without claiming authority beyond the preflight function.
result_logic.fail: The package omits an applicable governed check, lacks required evidence or model-state identity, contains unresolved untraced deviations, or asserts acceptance/sign-off authority not granted by the governing workflow.
result_logic.not_applicable: The governing workflow does not require a Revit preflight evidence package for the tested state.
result_logic.indeterminate: The applicable check profile, model state, or higher-level workflow requirement cannot be determined from available evidence.

provenance.migration_note: Round 006 adds a packaging/completeness test so Revit preflight evidence can be consumed by W7.2 and other gates without conflating evidence production with approval authority.
